title: Mike Macdonald wants Seahawks to "focus on recapturing us"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Macdonald wants Seahawks to "focus on recapturing us"
sources.description: After Monday night's loss to the Bears, Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said that his team was beaten in all three phases of the game and he revisited that line of thinking on Tuesday.
